name: Yngvil Vatn Guttu
bio: Yngvil Vatn Guttu is an internationally acclaimed trumpeter, guitarist, composer, and arranger based in Anchorage, Alaska. She offers comprehensive instruction spanning brass techniques, acoustic & electric guitar, bass, songwriting, composition, and vocal breathing control for students of all experience levels.
rates: Contact for private lesson rates & schedules

name: Alaska Jazz Workshop
bio: The Alaska Jazz Workshop is a non-profit music education initiative providing youth and adults across Alaska with top-tier jazz education, improvisation clinics, summer jazz camps, and ensemble performance opportunities led by veteran master educators.

name: Ed Washington
bio: Ed Washington is a soulful vocalist, music producer, and director of The Sanctuary Collective AK. Ed specializes in voice coaching, vocal range enhancement, breathing technique, stage posture, and gospel/contemporary vocal styling.

name: John Damberg
bio: John Damberg is one of Alaska's most distinguished percussionists, bandleaders, and educators. Founder of the John Damberg Latin Jazz Quintet, John provides instruction in drum set fundamentals, mallet percussion, Latin rhythm structures, and piano harmony.

name: Joy Kil (Joy's Music Studio)
bio: Joy Kil operates Joy's Music Studio in Anchorage, providing gentle, disciplined, and inspiring classical music instruction in cello and piano for children, teenagers, and adult learners.

name: Kat Moore
bio: Kat Moore (frontwoman of Super Saturated Sugar Strings and The Forest That Leaps) is a beloved multi-instrumentalist, singer-songwriter, and music teacher in Anchorage. Kat teaches creative songwriting, multi-instrumental fluency, and expressive vocal techniques.

name: Miriah May
bio: Miriah May is an accomplished string teacher and performer specializing in violin, fiddle, viola, mandolin, and acoustic guitar. Miriah blends classical discipline with folk and bluegrass string fiddling for engaging, personalized music lessons.

name: Nick Petumenos
bio: Nicholas Petumenos is a versatile guitarist, bassist, drummer, keyboardist, and audio producer in Anchorage. Nick offers holistic music training covering instrument technique, groove, studio recording, and digital audio production.

name: Philip Giannulis
bio: Philip Giannulis is an energetic Anchorage drum instructor specializing in rock, metal, double-bass drum technique, limb independence, dynamic control, and metronome precision.

name: Rain Essex
bio: Rain Essex (GhozTKaT) is an electronic music producer and DJ instructor in Anchorage. Rain teaches computer-based music creation, Ableton Live session management, audio synthesis, mixing, and live DJ performance.
